# Shop upgrades

Upgrade cards are bought with points during a run and are gone when the run ends. There are **51 cards** in 4 tiers, and bigger shops deal higher tiers (see [the shop](basics.md#the-shop)).

Prices along the bottom of each card are for the 1st, 2nd and 3rd copy, before Haggler. "Copies from your tree" means copies the [meta tree](meta-tree.md) gives you at the start of a run.

<div class="rr-chips"><a class="rr-chip" href="#tier-1-cards" style="--ring: #22c55e">Tier 1: 6 cards</a><a class="rr-chip" href="#tier-2-cards" style="--ring: #3b82f6">Tier 2: 11 cards</a><a class="rr-chip" href="#tier-3-cards" style="--ring: #8b5cf6">Tier 3: 18 cards</a><a class="rr-chip" href="#tier-4-cards" style="--ring: #eab308">Tier 4: 16 cards</a></div>
